Commentary.Commentary: We are ready for the run chase. Paul Stirling and Kevin O'Brien will open the innings for Ireland. Kashif Daud to begin with the ball. Here he is, steaming in...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right. 124 needed for Ireland to snatch this match. Looking at the firepower they possess, you would expect them to win this clash. But, UAE will not make things easy for the Irishmen. Can UAE successfully defend this? We shall find out. Stay tuned for Ireland's reply.

Ireland flexed their muscles with the ball, right from the start. They always looked in charge of the innings and kept picking regular wickets to keep UAE on the back foot. They snatched 3 inside the Powerplay and kept the pressure on throughout. Curtis Campher was definitely the star of the show as he finished with figures of 4-1-19-3. Mark Adair had an expensive last over but was good regardless as he was economical and snared 2 wickets. White was pretty good too as he removed two UAE batters. Josh Little only gave away 19 in his quota and bowled very smartly. Overall, a combined bowling display from the Irish lads.

A brilliant bowling display by Ireland and they will be mighty pleased to have restricted UAE to a total of 123. It never felt like UAE were in control in this innings and they have finished on a low total, but will be happy that they got some momentum towards the end. Not much to talk about regarding their batting as most of their batters faltered and could not leave a lasting impact. They needed a good platform to begin the innings but they never found it, as, by the end of the Powerplay, they had already lost 3 wickets. Hameed hung around for a brief time before departing too. Then, came a decent stand between Muhammad Usman and Vriitya Aravind and it looked like they could reach the 140 or 150-run mark when these two stitched their 47-run stand, but the wicket of Usman saw UAE slip from 92/4 to 96/7. Towards the end, Daud and Raza slammed a few boundaries and helped them end strongly.

FOUR! 15 from the last over and it's a strong finish from UAE. Adair attempts for a yorker but ends up serving a full toss on the pads, Daud deflects it neatly wide of short fine leg for a boundary. United Arab Emirates finish on 123/7!
Short and around off, Kashif pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Adair responds with a sharp delivery. Follows the batsman down the leg side with a full delivery, Daud swings and misses.
SIX! Dismissed! Adair overdoes his slower one, full and around off, Daud skips down the track and launches it over long on for a biggie.

Follows the batsman down the leg side with a slower short ball, Raza somehow keeps it out on the leg side and attempts for a run. Adair gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Raza survives.
Slower one, full and dipping in around off, the batsman walks down the track and tickles it towards deep mid-wicket. Two runs.
Fuller ball, on the stumps, Kashif Daud drills it towards the long on region and takes a couple.
Length ball, on off, Ahmed Raza gets across and looks to heave it towards the on side but gets the inside half of his blade to square leg for a single.
Full ball, on off, Kashif Daud forces it down the ground to long off for a single.
Length ball, outside off, Kashif Daud looks to cut but misses.
Short ball, slower, around off, Ahmed Raza punches it off the back foot to point for a single.
SIX! Crunched! Full ball, on the leg stump, Ahmed Raza makes room and lifts it with a straight bat over long off for a biggie. Ahmed Raza the captain leading from the front.
Short and on off, no pace on offer, Raza gets back and pulls it through mid on for one. Only two runs and a wicket from the 18th over.
Josh Little (3-0-8-0) to bowl the penultimate over.
Another leg cutter, delivered from the back of the hand on a length outside off, Raza pushes at it and misses.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The bowler outfoxes the batter with a clever change in pace. Slower and outside off, on a fuller length, Vriitya Aravind tries for the paddle scoop by walking across the stumps but only manages to lob it towards the keeper. Neil Rock takes a simple catch to dismiss Aravind.
Commentary.Howout: c Neil Rock b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: In strides the skipper, Ahmed Raza.
Swing and a miss! Slower one, a leg cutter outside off, Vriitya Aravind goes hard at it but fails to connect.
Short again, around off, pulled towards wide long on for a single.
Back of a length, around off, the batter tries to play the cross-batted shot but fails to connect. That one stayed a touch low too.
Fuller, outside off, Vriitya Aravind drives it straight to the cover fielder at the ring. Another dot ball! End of Benjamin White's spell, a good outing for him - 2/24.
Fuller ball, on the stumps, Vriitya Aravind pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter length, on the pads, Vriitya Aravind pulls it towards the mid-wicket zone for a couple. Could have been risky in case of a direct hit at the keeper's end.
Full toss, on the stumps, Kashif Daud pushes it to long on for a single.
Mark Adair (2-0-12-1) is back into the attack.

OUT! A golden duck for the birthday boy. Slightly short and around off, Rohan stays back and tries to cut but it possibly takes a chunk of his bat and deflects onto the stumps. The leggie has two now and UAE are back on the back foot after a period of recovery. Benjamin White is on a hat-trick.
Kashif Daud walks out and will be facing the Hat-trick ball now!
Rohan Mustafa walks in next.

OUT! Benjamin White gets the breakthrough! Benjamin White fires this again, wide outside the off stump. Muhammad Usman skips down the track and looks to slog it towards the mid-wicket region but misses. Neil Rock does the rest and whips the bails off. The 47-run stand is broken.
Commentary.Howout: st Neil Rock b Benjamin White

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! Benjamin White fires this way too wide, outside the off stump. Muhammad Usman looks to cut but misses. Wided.
Full and outside off, this one is stroked through covers for a couple of runs.
Outside off, Vriitya Aravind flashes and misses.
Rohan Mustafa walks out.
Quicker and flatter on middle, too full in length, Aravind digs it out back to the bowler who collects and appeals for a catch. Bump ball.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for a run.
Fires it very full and on middle, Muhammad Usman tries to work it away but misses.
Fullish and on middle, forced down to long on for a run.
Flatter again, this time, outside off, dabbed to point for one more. An expensive over from White, 13 off it.
Shortish, on the hips, nurdled through square leg for one.

FOUR! What a good shot. 10 runs off the last 2 balls and it looks like Usman has decided to cut loose. Fuller again, on off, Muhammad Usman skips down the track and drags this one in between long on and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

SIX! Finally, he gets hold of one properly and bags a biggie! Tossed up, fuller, around off, Muhammad Usman gets down on one knee and whacks this one over deep mid-wicket. The man in the deep thought he had a chance but it flew over him.
Darted on middle, nicely nudged through mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter around off, Aravind taps this to point and wants a run but he is sent back.
Benjamin White is back into the attack.
Flatter, on the pads, again, Vriitya Aravind works it towards the mid on region for a single.
On the pads, flatter, Muhammad Usman works it towards the mid-wicket area for a single.
On the pads, fuller, Vriitya Aravind tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter length, again, Muhammad Usman pulls it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Half-tracker and Muhammad Usman takes full advantage of it. He rocks back and pulls it towards the deep square leg area for a much-needed boundary.
Flatter ball, on the stumps, Muhammad Usman dances down the track but decides to block it in the end.
A length ball, on middle and leg, a speedy delivery, the tuck is missed and the ball pings the pad. An appeal for LBW but this one was going down leg. The batters sneak in a leg bye.
A pacy shortish ball outside off, Usman flashes his blade but fails to connect.
WIDE. Little loses his radar here. Slips it down the leg side, the tuck is missed by Usman.
One run this time as Aravind taps this one down towards third man.
Leg bye. Again, on a length but on the pads, Usman misses his tuck but takes a leg bye as the ball takes the pad and rolls to the on side.
Width offered outside off, it is served on a length, Muhammad Usman slaps this one behind point and the man in the deep runs to his right and stops the ball. Two taken.
Slower in pace, on a length and on the pads, Usman looks to clip it but misses and gets pinged on the pad.
Change in bowling. The leggie gets replaced from this end and it's Josh Little (2-0-4-0) returning into the attack.
Off pace delivery, outside off, Vriitya Aravind tries to push at it but misses. End of Curtis Campher's spell, he ends with superb figures, 4-1-19-3.
Back of a length, on the pads, Muhammad Usman works it towards the mid-wicket area for a single.
Length ball, around off, Vriitya Aravind dabs it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length, on the hips, Muhammad Usman pulls it towards the fine leg area for a single.
Length ball, on the pads, Vriitya Aravind clips it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, on the stumps, Muhammad Usman pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle, nudged through square leg this time for one. 5 off White's second over.
Around off, hit through covers and the strike is rotated.
Tossed up this time, fuller outside off, Vriitya Aravind gets on his knee and looks to slash this away but misses. Rock collects it behind the sticks and goes 'HOWZAT?' but the umpire is unmoved.
Another single for UAE as this fuller ball is nicely tucked through square leg.
Flatter this time, outside off, dabbed to point for a quick run.
Loopy around off, eased down gently through mid off for one.
Length ball, outside off, Muhammad Usman punches it to cover-point for a single. 50/4 at the halfway mark!
FOUR! Back of a length, around off, Muhammad Usman stays on the back foot and pulls it towards the mid-wicket area for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off, Muhammad Usman slashes his bat at that but misses.
Vriitya Aravind is the new batsman.

OUT! Curtis Campher strikes again! Short ball, on off, Basil Hameed goes for the pull shot but miscues it completely. The ball goes high in the air off the top edge and Josh Little comes forward from short fine leg to take an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Little b Curtis Campher

Commentary.Commentary: Slower, full toss, outside off, Muhammad Usman skips down the track and pushes it to long on for a single.
Length ball, outside off, Basil Hameed dabs it to third man for a single.
A brilliant over by White, just 2 off it! On middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
A touch flatter this time, around off, again, the ball spits up slightly after landing as Hameed misses his cut and the ball goes just over the off pole to the keeper.
The first runs off White's bowling! Outside off, a touch shorter, slapped behind point for a single.
Fuller, around off, this is jammed back to White.
This time, Usman connects with this fuller ball but finds the fielder at covers.
Flatter, outside off, the ball lands and shoots up. Takes Usman by surprise as he looks to slash it away but misses.
Change in bowling. Benjamin White to bowl his leggies.
Full ball, Basil Hameed punches it straight down the ground and the long on fielder cuts it off near the fence. Two taken. Another tidy over from Curtis Campher.
WIDE! Curtis Campher drags this down the leg side. Basil Hameed looks to clip it but the ball is way down the leg side. Wide called.
Length ball, on the pads, Basil Hameed clips it to fine leg and takes a couple.
Full toss, on the stumps, Muhammad Usman pushes it to long on for a single.
Campher goes short around off, Basil Hameed looks to pull but miscues. The ball goes in the air but falls in no man's area at mid-wicket. The batsmen cross.
Back of a length, on off, Basil Hameed looks to pull but gets no timing on that as the ball just travels to mid-wicket. Campher is yet to concede a run.

Length ball, on the stumps, Basil Hameed looks to clip it off his pads, but misses. The ball hits his pads and rolls on towards the on side. Muhammad Usman at the non striker's end wants a single but Basil Hameed sends him back as Curtis Campher has a shy at the non striker's end.

Fuller around off, Usman taps this to covers. Hameed wants a run and runs ahead but Usman sends him back. A throw is sent back to the bowler but Basil made his way back in quickly. 8 from the over, Simi continues to leak runs.
Basil Hameed rotates the strike by pushing this fuller ball down to long on.
Another dot as Hameed just defends this one back to the bowler.

SIX! BANG! That is more like it from UAE. They need to start scoring boundaries freely now. Floated, fuller, around off, Basil Hameed gets low and mows a slog-sweep high and mighty over deep mid-wicket.
On middle, Hameed pushes it back to Simi.
Tossed up, fuller around off, knocked down to the long on region for a run.
Simi Singh is back on. He went for 10 runs in his first over.
Good length around off, angling in, Basil helps it defensively to mid-wicket. End of a splendid over, a double-wicket maiden for Curtis Campher!

OUT! That is a very fine caught and bowled. United Arab Emirates are in a lot of trouble now. Curtis Campher slants in a length ball, around off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan is early into his attempted drive and chips it to the left of the bowler. Campher reacts quickly and grabs it with both hands. He is off in celebration, Ireland are on fire!
Out walks Basil Hameed.

A muted appeal for an lbw, probably an inside edge has saved the batter. Full and around off, nipping back in and striking Rizwan on the back leg. The bowler appeals but then realizes that it's off the inside edge.
Fuller and around off, angling in, Rizwan presents a straight bat and pushes it to mid off.

OUT! Two down inside the Powerplay and UAE are again off to a sorry start. Chirag Suri departs this time. Fuller in length around off, the intention from Suri was to go downtown but only manages to slice it towards covers. George Dockrell keeps his eyes on the ball and completes the catch safely.
Commentary.Howout: c George Dockrell b Curtis Campher

Commentary.Commentary: The new man is Muhammad Usman!
Beaten! Shortish and outside around off, Suri feels for it and gets beaten.
Back of a length, around off, it's punched towards cover-point for a brisk run.
A slow dipping full toss on middle, Suri flicks it in front of square leg for a single.
Angling in from around off, it's worked with soft hands to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and around off, angling in, it's flicked aerially behind square leg. Two runs taken this time.
Turns a length ball in the gap on the leg side for a single.
Width outside off, stroked through covers for a couple.

FOUR! Could have also been a stumping or a caught behind, but, it is neither. Singh tosses this one up, landing fuller outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan skips down the track and looks to work this one away but the ball seems to have taken a slight outside edge, towards the keeper. Neil Rock is not able to stop it or hold on. The ball runs away to the third man fence.  10 from the over!
Chundangapoyil Rizwan again tucks this to mid-wicket but only for a dot, this time.
Darted on middle, Suri turns this towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Floated and full, around off, Suri uses his feet and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Full again, on middle, knocked down to long on for a run.
Fuller and on middle, the batsman tries to flick but it takes the inner half and goes behind square leg.
Change. Spin early on as Simi Singh is handed the ball now.
Little bowls the outswinger and beats the bat, this time against Suri. Outside off, Chirag Suri tries to drive but misses. 9/1 after 3 overs, a very slow start from United Arab Emirates.
Rizwan opens his account on the fifth delivery. On a length and around off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan plays it with a soft bottom hand and guides it to third man for a single.
Beaten all ends up again. Full and outside off, moving away from the batter, Rizwan tries for a flashy drive away from his body and misses.
Nicely bowled again. Beating the bat with his pace and movement. On a length and outside off, Rizwan pokes inside the line and misses.
Another delivery in the channel outside off, on a length and leaving the batter, Chundangapoyil Rizwan pushes at it tamely and misses.
Full in length and outside off, angling across, Rizwan has nothing to do with it.
FOUR! Deft! On a length and outside off, Suri uses the pace of the bowler and plays it late. He places it wide of short third man and gets the first boundary of the match.

OUT! Caught in the deep! This is good bowling from Adair. He goes short and has already placed a fielder in the deep at square leg. Waseem turns inside the crease to fetch to play his pull shot but it comes from the top half of his blade. The connection is not crisp and it flies in the deep. Gareth Delany runs across to his right and goes down to complete the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Gareth Delany b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Chundangapoyil Rizwan walks out now!
A well-directed bouncer, around off, Waseem wants to upper-cut it but it goes closely past his gloves.
Back of a length, around off, Suri goes on his toes and taps it down next to the pitch for a quick run.
Effort ball from Mark, bowls it a bit short and outside off, moving slightly away with some extra bounce, Chirag lets it go to the keeper.
Adair begins with a gentle full ball around off, Chirag gets behind the line and pushes it from the middle of his bat to cover-point.

Edgy again! Fuller from the bowler, on middle and moving back in a shade, Suri tries to dig it out but the ball takes the inner edge and goes to short fine leg. The fielder there dives across to his left to stop the ball but cannot prevent the single. A quiet start from UAE, just 3 from the first over.
Who will bowl from this end? It will be Mark Adair!

Full in length on middle, shaping in a bit, Waseem tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball deflects towards cover-point and they pinch a single as the fielder misses his shy at the striker's end.
Slightly fuller and outside off, Chirag plays a mistimed drive towards point. They cross for a run and UAE are away.
Play and a miss! There is some kick from the surface on this delivery. On a length and outside off, Chirag throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
Angles it across the batsman, on a length and leaving the batsman, Suri drops his wrists and allows it through to the keeper.
Good start from Little. Right on the money. A bit short and around off, Suri stays on the back foot and defends it down on the surface.

We are ready for all the action to get underway! The Irish players make their way out into the middle. Chirag Suri and Waseem Muhammad will open the innings for UAE. Josh Little to steam in with the ball. Here we go...
Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Kevin O'Brien (C), Andy Balbirnie, Gareth Delany, George Dockrell, Neil Rock (WK), Curtis Campher, Benjamin White, Josh Little, Mark Adair, Simi Singh.

United Arab Emirates (Playing XI) - Ahmed Raza (C), Basil Hameed, Chirag Suri, Kashif Daud, Muhammad Usman, Chundangapoyil Rizwan, Rohan Mustafa, Sanchit Sharma, Vriitya Aravind (WK), Waseem Muhammad, Zahoor Khan.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of United Arab Emirates. They will bat first.

Hello and welcome to match 2 of the UAE Summer T20 Bash, 2021 between the hosts, UAE and Ireland. Talking about UAE, they lost the first match of this 7-match T20I series to Namibia and are up against an even tougher opponent in this match. Ireland, on the other hand, are coming after a series win against Zimbabwe and will be high on confidence. They will be looking to fine-tune their preparation ahead of the all-important T20 World Cup. Can UAE lift themselves and challenge Ireland here? Or will the strong Irish unit dominate this encounter? We shall find out soon. Stay tuned for toss and further updates.
... MATCH DAY ...
